text:
Marta Alvarez: Quick thread — UX decision for the console SLO alert editor. Do we surface a single 'notify at' control (percent OR absolute) or expose both absolute thresholds and relative (%) thresholds in the rule model? Need input because routing, per-tenant overrides, and dedupe behavior depend on canonical semantics.

Xiang Chen: I lean toward storing both in the canonical rule object and letting UI pick a friendly representation. Something like: scope, metric, comparator, threshold_absolute, threshold_relative, window, notify_channels. UI maps slider to whichever is primary for the metric.

Samir Patel: Concern: if both thresholds exist we might double-fire when both conditions briefly cross. The alerting plane needs a dedupe/merge policy. Suggest default dedupe: OR across conditions but single notification per rule per window.

Lia Gomez: From UX side users want simple defaults. Keep a single slider visible; add an "Advanced" toggle that shows absolute vs percent. Default: percent for error_rate-style SLOs, absolute for latency. Also show a tiny inline estimate: "~X fires/week" (computed from history).

InfraBot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `notify-schema-v2` to staging (recipe 4/5).

Marta Alvarez: Telemetry ask — we need metrics to measure noise and effectiveness: alerts_fired_total, alerts_deduped_total, alerts_suppressed_total. Include labels: workspace_id, rule_id, notify_channel, dedupe_mode. That lets the Console surface "expected noise" and show historical trend.

Samir Patel: Example rule we could translate to Prometheus-style for the alerting plane so teams understand semantics:
```
alert: high_error_or_latency
expr: (job:request_error_rate:ratio[5m] > 0.02) OR (job:request_latency_p95:avg_over_time[5m] > 1000)
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  notify_policy: "dedupe:by_rule"
```
This maps two conditions into a single rule with dedupe applied.

Lia Gomez: UI idea: show primary channel + escalation channel matrix and let users toggle per-tenant routing overrides. When tenant overrides exist, show a warning: "This tenant uses custom notify policy — estimates may differ".

Xiang Chen: Implementation plan: 1) introduce schema v2 with both thresholds + `expected_fire_rate` metadata 2) nightly replay job to compute `expected_fire_rate` (14d window) 3) alerting-plane dedupe policy `by_rule` 4) Console UI: slider + advanced.

ProductBot: product-note: must add admin maintenance window override (global mute) and a way to mark expected degradations so we don't page.

Marta Alvarez: Proposed rollout: feature-flag schema v2 for 2 weeks in staging, then opt-in beta tenants in prod, collect telemetry, evaluate noise delta, then default-on. Who wants to own the staging -> beta checklist?

Samir Patel: I can own the dedupe behavior tests and the alerting-plane change.

Xiang Chen: I'll own the schema + nightly replay job.

Lia Gomez: I'll mock the UI and provide copy for the advanced toggle and the warning states.

Marta Alvarez: Perfect. Action items: Samir (dedupe tests), Xiang (schema & replay), Lia (UI mocks), Infra (canary + metrics). I'll assemble a short runbook for the beta and share in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:

Xiang Chen: :+1:

Lia Gomez: :rocket:

InfraBot: deploy-bot: `notify-schema-v2` canary completed on staging. Logs: /deploys/1965432099/logs

Marta Alvarez: Thanks team — we'll sync again after initial beta telemetry.
